about.title: About us
about.lead: Auto Design EMY is a workshop in Vogošća specialising in car interior re-covering and upholstery.
p: We work on steering wheels, seats, gear knobs and handbrakes, armrests, door panels, dashboards and headliners. We also offer seat repair, steering wheel reshaping and deep cleaning.

You choose the material – leather, perforated leather, Alcantara, fabric or leatherette – and combinations of them, as well as the thread colour. That way your interior gets exactly the look you want.
We regularly post our work on Instagram, Facebook and TikTok, where you can see finished steering wheels, seats and interiors before you contact us.
